name: universal_multiconvex_sat_torque_v1
protocol_note: Strictly separate from original 9D benchmarks; universal M=2 convex-part decomposition [b_min, b_max] per rigid body from simulator collision primitives. Baselines retrained on identical flattened 12D parts input (and dual-compared vs Stage 34 *_geo and original 9D).

baselines_budget.cophynet_mc: upstream CoPhyNet H=32 widened only at input to 21D [xyz(3), rot6(6), parts(12)], 50 epochs, lr=1e-3
baselines_budget.pets_mc: MBRL-Lib 7-member 4x200 SiLU ensemble, 25 epochs, 20-particle TS-inf with parts(12) in context
baselines_budget.ncii_mc: PointNet hidden=512, 2400 updates with parts(12) in object_embedding
